page.notes: Greek word "ὁμοθυμαδὸν" in the roman line is uncertain; marked [?]. The printed "fusq;" and "deq;" use a 3-like q mark, transcribed as q;. Long s is transcribed as s throughout (e.g. "sincerioris", "priscis"). Printed hyphens kept at line breaks ("obstri-gillare", "pri-scorum", "decurren-dum", "ca-chinnis", "Conscien-tiâ"). The final line "Nullius addicti jurare in verba magistri." is a Horace quotation set on its own indented line, so it is a separate paragraph. The margin note has tildes over eorũ and templũ as printed.
